source_access_note: Same public Medfield / Hillside Village PDF used for the active A-1 single-sheet case. P40-02 tracks the full 9-page plan/elevation set as a multi-plan intake gate, not as an active benchmark.

intended_scope.goal: Capture a real multi-sheet plan/elevation set for future expected-inventory authoring and multi-plan artifact benchmarking.
intended_scope.selected_sheet_strategy: Review all pages first, then promote only plan sheets with human-reviewed expected inventory for drawing_understanding, sheet_graphs, and sheet_issues checks.
intended_scope.non_goal: This intake row does not claim current recognition success on the full real plan set.

promotion_rule: Promote from pending_fixture only after full-run artifacts are committed or privately reproducible, and a human-reviewed expected inventory covers every selected plan sheet. If artifacts exist but current recognition misses the expected inventory, promote first as known_gap rather than active.
expected_inventory_authoring_notes: Annotate sheet type and page index for each selected plan sheet.
Record coarse room/opening/corridor/stair/dimension counts with evidence notes.
Record required sheet_graphs page indexes and per-sheet component count ranges.
Record sheet_issues preview expectations separately from primary issues.json because P39 keeps per-sheet issues as candidate preview only.
